name: The Graveyards of Alterac
summary: Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl asks you to assault an Alliance graveyard in Alterac Valley, then return to her in the Alterac Mountains.

sections.title: A Graveyard Assault
sections.body: In the Alterac Mountains, Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl sends you to assault a graveyard. Then you are to return to her.

faq.q: Who asks me to assault a graveyard?
faq.answer: Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl, in the Alterac Mountains, asks you to assault a graveyard in Alterac Valley.
The graveyards are in Alterac Valley. Pick one held by the Alliance, marked by an Alliance banner.

faq.q: What does Teeka ask me to do?
faq.answer: Teeka asks you to assault a graveyard, then return to her in the Alterac Mountains.
